HTTP2::concurrency
Description
This command can be used to determine the number of active concurrent
streams in the current HTTP/2 session. Returns number of active
concurrent streams in the current HTTP/2 session.
Syntax
HTTP2
::
concurrency
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
log
local0.
"Number of active concurrent streams is [HTTP2::concurrency]"
}
